scenarios.name: Bull
scenarios.notes: Pinduoduo dominates domestic value e-commerce, monetization improves, and Temu becomes a profitable global platform.

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.notes: Steady growth: Pinduoduo matures yet grows with China, Temu achieves mixed success and roughly breakeven economics.

scenarios.name: Bear
scenarios.notes: Moat erosion: domestic growth stalls, Temu struggles to reach profitability, margins compress under subsidies and regulation.

evidence_for: Extremely strong domestic cash flow with forward P/E < 12x and net cash ~30% of market cap.
Temu semi-managed model successfully lowering cross-border logistics friction and de minimis risks.
Agricultural supply chain digitization creating deep buyer frequency stickiness in tier 2-4 cities.
evidence_against: Management intentional guidance lowering profit expectations and increasing merchant support spend.
Cross-border geopolitical friction, US/EU de minimis customs revision risks.
Domestic competitive intensity from Taobao/Tmall price-matching initiatives.
open_questions: What is the steady-state operating margin of Temu as subsidies normalize?
Will shareholder capital return (dividends/buybacks) materialize or remain on balance sheet?

predictions.claim: Temu achieves EBITDA breakeven across major developed markets by end of 2026
predictions.notes: Key catalyst for unlocking multiple re-rating from single-digit P/E.

decision_journal.situation: PDD trades at deep value multiples (~10x P/E) reflecting China country risk and capex redeployment.
alternatives_rejected: Exit position (rejected: cash generation and Temu optionality offer asymmetric upside).
Increase to overweight (rejected: macro volatility and capital allocation opacity justify controlled sizing).
